goal.en: Express rules, obligations, advice and permission with the right modal verb.
goal.ar: أن تعبّر عن القواعد والواجب والنصيحة والإذن بالفعل الناقص المناسب.

text.en: must = the speaker's own strong feeling or a written rule. have to = an outside obligation (a law, a boss, a schedule).
text.ar: must تعبّر عن إلزام نابع من المتكلم أو من قاعدة مكتوبة، وhave to تعبّر عن إلزام خارجي مثل القانون أو العمل.

text.en: The negatives mean different things! “You mustn't smoke” = it is forbidden. “You don't have to smoke” = it is not necessary.
text.ar: انتبه: نفياهما مختلفان تماماً. mustn't تعني «ممنوع»، وdon't have to تعني «غير مطلوب منك».

items.en: I have to work on Saturday.
You don't have to pay — it's free.

text.en: should + base verb gives advice — softer than must: You should see a doctor.
text.ar: should مع الفعل المجرد للنصيحة، وهي أخف من must: You should see a doctor.

items.ar: لا ينبغي أن يعمل إلى وقت متأخر.
هل ينبغي أن أتصل بها الآن؟

text.en: Modals never take -s and never take “to”: “He should to go” and “He shoulds go” are both wrong.
text.ar: الأفعال الناقصة لا تأخذ s ولا to. فلا نقول He should to go ولا He shoulds go.

text.en: Can I…? (everyday) · Could I…? (more polite) · May I…? (formal). All are followed by the base verb.
text.ar: Can I للاستخدام اليومي، وCould I أكثر تهذيباً، وMay I رسمية. ويأتي بعدها الفعل مجرداً.

items.en: Could you speak more slowly, please?

items.ar: هل تسمح لي بالمغادرة مبكراً اليوم؟

questions.sentence: Passengers ___ show their tickets before boarding.

explanation.en: A written rule → must + base verb, no “to”, no -s.
explanation.ar: قاعدة مكتوبة، فنستخدم must مع الفعل المجرد بلا to وبلا s.

questions.sentence: She ___ start work at seven every day.

explanation.ar: إلزام خارجي مع she، فنستخدم has to.

prompt.en: “You don't have to come.” What does it mean?
prompt.ar: ماذا تعني You don't have to come؟

options: It is not necessary for you to come.
You are not allowed to come.

explanation.en: don't have to = no obligation. Forbidding is “mustn't”.
explanation.ar: don't have to تعني عدم وجود إلزام، أما المنع فيُعبَّر عنه بـ mustn't.

commonMistake.en: Learners often read “don't have to” as “forbidden”. It is the opposite: it removes the obligation.
commonMistake.ar: يظن كثيرون أن don't have to تعني المنع، وهي في الحقيقة ترفع الإلزام لا أكثر.

questions.sentence: You ___ touch that — it's very hot!
I ___ work yesterday because it was a holiday.

explanation.en: “Must” has no past form; use “didn't have to” for the past.
explanation.ar: لا ماضي لـ must، فنستخدم didn't have to للتعبير عن الماضي.
النصيحة تُعبَّر عنها بـ should مع الفعل المجرد.

explanation.en: No “to” after should: He should study more.
explanation.ar: لا نضع to بعد should. الصواب He should study more.

prompt.en: Your friend has a bad headache. What is the best advice?
prompt.ar: صديقك يعاني صداعاً شديداً. ما أفضل نصيحة؟

options: You should take a break and drink water.

explanation.en: Only the first sentence is grammatical: should + base verb.
explanation.ar: الجملة الأولى وحدها صحيحة نحوياً: should مع الفعل المجرد.

questions.answer: You shouldn't eat so much sugar

prompt.en: You are in a job interview and need to leave ten minutes early. What do you say?
prompt.ar: أنت في مقابلة عمل وتحتاج المغادرة مبكراً بعشر دقائق. ماذا تقول؟

options: Could I leave ten minutes early, please?

explanation.en: “Could I…, please?” fits a formal situation; “Can I go now?” is too casual here.
explanation.ar: صيغة Could I…, please؟ تناسب الموقف الرسمي، أما Can I go now؟ فعامية في هذا السياق.

questions.sentence: ___ you help me with this box, please?

explanation.en: “Could you…?” is the normal polite request.
explanation.ar: Could you…؟ هي صيغة الطلب المهذب المعتادة.

prompt.en: Match the modal with its meaning.

explanation.en: Each modal carries one core meaning — learn the meaning, not just the word.
explanation.ar: لكل فعل ناقص معنى جوهري، والأهم أن تحفظ المعنى لا الكلمة وحدها.

prompt.en: Which pair of sentences means the SAME?
prompt.ar: أي زوج من الجمل يحمل المعنى نفسه؟

options: You mustn't tell anyone. / Don't tell anyone.
You mustn't tell anyone. / You don't have to tell anyone.
You don't have to come. / You can't come.
You must come. / You can come.

explanation.en: “Mustn't” = a prohibition, so it matches a negative imperative.
explanation.ar: mustn't تعني المنع، فتساوي صيغة الأمر المنفي «لا تخبر أحداً».

questions.sentence: It's a museum, so you ___ take photos with a flash, and you ___ speak loudly either.

explanation.en: Flash photography is forbidden (mustn't); speaking loudly is impolite rather than illegal (shouldn't).
explanation.ar: التصوير بالفلاش ممنوع فنستخدم mustn't، أما رفع الصوت فمسألة ذوق لا منع، فنستخدم shouldn't.

options: Can I ask you a question?
Could you to open the door?

explanation.en: No “to” after could: Could you open the door?
explanation.ar: لا نضع to بعد could. الصواب Could you open the door?
